blocks.orig: Located just outside Arusha’s city centre in the village of Sakina, Africa Safari Arusha is a comfortable lodge at the feet of Mount Meru. The lodge boasts 8 standard rooms in a main building and 8 luxury rooms spread over 4 stand-alone circular buildings. The rooms are decorated in African style, each with a sitting area with modern furniture, a large bathroom and large windows to provide a lot of light. In the lush gardens, you can plunge into the swimming pool and enjoy a drink and meal at the bar and restaurant. A lovely place to relax before or after your safari.
blocks.html: In the village of Sakina, just outside Arusha’s city centre, Africa Safari Arusha is a comfortable lodge at the foot of Mount Meru. There are 8 standard rooms in the main building, plus 8 luxury rooms divided over 4 separate round buildings. Each African-style room has a seating area with modern furniture, a big bathroom and large windows that let in plenty of light. In the green gardens you can take a dip in the swimming pool and enjoy a drink and a meal at the bar and restaurant. A pleasant place to unwind before or after your safari.
